title: When Lexical Change Misleads: Rethinking Dynamic Topic Model Evaluation with Traditional and LLM-Based Metrics
abstract: arXiv:2608.13835v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dynamic topic models capture evolving word distributions, but traditional coherence metrics may fail when vocabulary changes while semantic meaning persists. We evaluate 120 topics from CoNTM and DLDA across NYT, DBLP, and arXiv, using three human annotators and Low, Medium, and High lexical-change categories. Traditional temporal coherence shows highly variable agreement with human judgments ($\rho$=-0.256 to 0.614). In contrast, LLM-based semantic similarity agrees strongly with human semantic judgments for CoNTM on NYT ($\rho$=0.609), DBLP ($\rho$=0.721), and arXiv ($\rho$=0.502), but is less consistent for DLDA. Lexical-change stratification reveals variation hidden by aggregate evaluation. We therefore advocate lexical-change-aware evaluation, jointly reporting traditional coherence and LLM-based semantic measures as complementary rather than interchangeable signals.

translated_title: 当词汇变化误导时：用传统与基于大语言模型的指标重新思考动态主题模型评估
translated_abstract: 动态主题模型捕捉不断演变的词汇分布，但当词汇变化而语义保持不变时，传统的连贯性指标可能失效。我们评估了来自CoNTM和DLDA在NYT、DBLP和arXiv数据集上的120个主题，使用了三位人工标注者以及低、中、高词汇变化类别。传统的时序连贯性在与人类判断的一致性上表现出高度变异性（ρ=-0.256至0.614）。相比之下，基于大语言模型的语义相似性在CoNTM上于NYT（ρ=0.609）、DBLP（ρ=0.721）和arXiv（ρ=0.502）上与人类语义判断高度一致，但在DLDA上一致性较差。词汇变化分层揭示了聚合评估所隐藏的差异。因此，我们提倡采用词汇变化感知的评估方法，将传统连贯性和基于大语言模型的语义度量作为互补而非可互换的信号联合报告。
tldr: 本文提出动态主题模型评估应结合传统连贯性与基于大语言模型的语义指标，并考虑词汇变化分层，以避免词汇变化导致的评估误导。
en_tdlr: This paper advocates for lexical-change-aware evaluation in dynamic topic models, jointly reporting traditional coherence and LLM-based semantic metrics as complementary signals to avoid misleading assessments.
